verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly claim 'all the packages, tools and runtimes... ready for use with just a single command' plus container tooling and easy package management, directly matching the story. However, there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of this specific claim, and community evidence about package/app installation friction (e.g. needing extra steps for certain apps, Flatpak complaints) raises some doubt about the seamlessness. Missing for 10: independent verification of the 'single command' setup claim, and details on which runtimes/languages are included out of the box.
